reviews.author: Terry K
reviews.text: If you are lucky enough to obtain Romero to perform any services for you then I am sure you will be pleased. I've worked with and around Edgar for over 20 years. once again he came through for me and did nothing but an excellent professional job. The man is a problem solver. There is no question or doubt why he is continuously busy.

reviews.author: Heather Nelder
reviews.text: Within a week, I had reached out to Romero's for an estimate, received a quote, and had the work completed. Edgar was professional and knowledgeable, and Hernando did the work efficiently. He even installed a safety mechanism in our breaker box and explained why and how it was necessary. I love these guys.

reviews.author: Ginger Leary
reviews.text: He did good work for us and was promp, professional, and efficient. I would use him again and highly recommend him
